title: BirdCLEF 2026 priors research
subtitle: Hour priors (pseudo + iNat) + Perch calibration + missing-class strategy
description:
Six CSV tables derived from local analysis of the BC2026 pseudo-cache + labeled soundscape data + iNaturalist API hour distributions:

1. **combined_hour_prior.csv** (24 x 234) — hybrid prior: pseudo for hours 0-10 + 17-23, iNat-filled for hours 11-16 (dead hours in train_soundscapes). Dense across all 24 hours so no dead-hour clipping. Bruce + combined_prior w=2.5 lifts macro-AUC by +0.07 on labeled OOF.
2. **pseudo_hour_priors.csv** (24 x 234) — pseudo-only hour priors, has 0s for hours 11-16. Kept for backwards compat.
3. **pseudo_site_hour_priors.csv** (120 x 234) — joint (site, hour) priors.
4. **pseudo_site_priors.csv** (21 x 234) — per-site species expectation.
5. **perch_calibration.csv** (234 rows) — Perch v2 systematic per-class bias ratios. Perch under-predicts 517063/24321 frogs by 100x and over-predicts compot1/compau/fepowl nightjars by 80x. Use log(ratio) as a logit shift.
6. **missing_class_strategy.csv** (28 rows) — per-class recovery strategy for the 28 BC2026 classes that have no train_audio (25 insect sonotypes + 3 frogs). Strategies: USE_PERCH, USE_HOURLY_PRIOR, BROADCAST_FROM(anchor).

Validated on Bruce Wu's 739-row labeled OOF benchmark. See inference_notebooks/sub_v7_combined_prior_autoscale.py in the source repo for the recipe.
